info.title: Resume Intelligence API
info.description: AI Resume Intelligence and Career Assistant. All scores are advisory indicators, not ATS scores or hiring probabilities.

schema.title: Response Live Api Health Live Get
Response Ready Api Health Ready Get
Response Verify Email Api Auth Verify Email Post
Response List Resumes Api Resumes Get

put.description:
User-reviewed (and possibly corrected) extraction becomes confirmed version 1.
Subsequent edits go through the versions API.

post.description:
Create a targeted resume (e.g. for a specific role) that starts from an existing
version. It shares the original upload, which is never modified.

get.description:
Short-lived signed download. The token is bound to the requesting user, so a leaked
link is useless to anyone else and expires after SIGNED_URL_TTL_SECONDS.
The published scoring rubric (weights, rules, rationale).

schema.title: Response List Versions Api Resumes  Resume Id  Versions Get

post.description:
Save a user edit as a new version. `base_version_id` must be the latest version
(optimistic concurrency) so edits made in another tab are never silently lost.
Undo/restore: creates a new latest version with the old content (history is append-only).

get.description: Compare two versions (any of the user's resumes): content diff + analysis deltas.

post.description: Always exports the latest saved version of the resume.

Cover letter from confirmed facts only. Unsupported claims are reported and the
letter is marked as needing review; placeholders mark facts the user must supply.

get.description:
Ranked pipeline for one opening, with shortlisting filters. Only people who applied (and consented)
or were uploaded with recruiter-attested consent appear.
Side-by-side: each requirement of the opening with every candidate's status and evidence.

delete.description: Remove an uploaded candidate (and their stored resume) before the automatic expiry.

post.description:
Add resumes of people who did not sign up themselves. The recruiter must attest that each person
agreed to be considered. Files are parsed in the sandbox; only extracted content is kept (encrypted),
and the candidate is deleted automatically after BULK_UPLOAD_RETENTION_DAYS.

get.description: Firm-level pipeline analytics. Aggregates only; no candidate identities.

Group outcomes from VOLUNTARY self-identification. Groups under FAIRNESS_MIN_GROUP people are suppressed.
Self-ID is never used for ranking; this report exists only to detect unequal outcomes.

post.description: Score unsaved edits against a target without saving anything. Same engine as the leaderboards.
Start setup: a new secret that only becomes active after a correct code is confirmed.

share_consent.title: Share Consent
share_consent.description: Candidate agrees that the HR team can see this resume version and score.

code.title: Code
code.description: 6-digit authenticator code or a recovery code

consent.title: Consent
consent.description: I agree this is used only for anonymous, aggregate fairness checks.
